title: client-telemetry-ingest-shim-sketch
content:
Purpose:
- Quick sketch: a small client-side telemetry "ingest shim" that standardizes event shape, enforces privacy filters, does adaptive sampling, and exposes a minimal API for SDKs and apps to send instrumentation without leaking PII or spiking production ingest costs.

Design goals:
- Single light-weight dependency for frontends and mobile clients.
- Deterministic, auditable sampling rules driven by remote config + local heuristics.
- Privacy-first by default: redaction + hash-only identifiers + opt-out hooks.
- Backpressure and offline buffering with size/QPS caps.
- Low cognitive overhead for app developers: 1 call to track(event) or annotate(context).

Constraints / assumptions:
- Ship in JS and Kotlin/Swift later.
- Must be able to run in environments with no persistent file system (mobile ephemeral).
- Network may be unreliable; prefer bounded in-memory queue + disk fallback when available.
- Events are small JSON; avoid deep nesting.

High-level flow (ascii):

  [app] ---> track(event) ---> [shim] ---> local queue ---> uploader ---> [collector]
                                        |                        ^
                                        |---> sampling decisions -|

Shim responsibilities (short list):
- Normalize events to schema v1 (flat keys)
- Apply privacy redaction rules (configurable allowlist/denylist)
- Add provenance metadata (sdk_version, platform, timestamp, anonymized_user_id)
- Run sampling policy to accept/reject or down-sample event
- Batch, compress, and upload with retry/backoff
- Expose diagnostics: queue_depth(), last_success_ts(), last_error

Event schema (flat, small):
- event_type: string (required)
- ts: iso8601 string (required)
- client_id: string (hashed, required)
- session_id: string (hashed, optional)
- seq: int (monotonic per session)
- category: string (optional) -- e.g., "prompt", "eval", "ui"
- props: map<string,string> (flattened into key prefixes: p_<k>)
- numeric_metrics: map<string,float> (n_<k>)
- provenance: (string fields concatenated) sdk:1.2.0|env:web|region:us-west
- privacy_flags: string comma list (e.g., "no-pii")

Notes on "flattened" props: we don't embed nested JSON to keep storage/indexing simple. Client code should convert deep objects to dotted keys (e.g., p_user_agent).

API surface (client-facing, minimal):
- init(config)
- track(event_type, props?, numeric_metrics?, opts?) -> returns boolean (queued|dropped)
- annotate_context(key, value) -> merges into subsequent events
- flush() -> promise resolves when queue emptied or timeout
- shutdown() -> synchronous drain with short TTL

Server ingest endpoint (collector interface) - shape we POST to:
POST /v1/telemetry/ingest
Headers: {"x-rw-client": "rw-sdk-js/1.2.0", "x-rw-shim-config": "hash"}
Body: {"batch_id": "uuid", "events": [<flattened-event>, ...], "metadata": "sdk+platform"}

Sampling DSL (local + remote):
- Simple rule language in remote config -> evaluated locally (no code push needed):
  rules:
    - id: "critical-errors"
      match: event_type == "error"
      action: sample_rate=1.0
    - id: "prompt-usage-high"
      match: category == "prompt" and props.p_prompt_length > 200
      action: sample_rate=0.2, max_per_minute=10
    - id: "default"
      match: true
      action: sample_rate=0.01

Runtime semantics:
- Each rule evaluated in priority order.
- Actions support: sample_rate (float 0..1), max_per_minute (int), holdout_bucket(n/1000) for deterministic bucketing (hash(client_id) % 1000 < n).
- Local counters reset using sliding windows; counters are best-effort (can be slightly over due to concurrency).

Privacy and PII handling:
- By default shim redacts any key that matches regex (email, phone, SSN-like).
- client_id/session_id MUST be hashed with HMAC-SHA256 using SDK key. Shim does NOT send raw PII.
- Provide allowlist for specific keys that apps can enable with review.
- Opt-out: sdk accepts userOptOut() which drops all event creation and deletes buffers.

Backoff & delivery guarantees:
- Best-effort, at-least-once within TTL (configurable, default 24h for non-sensitive events).
- Exponential backoff with jitter for 5xx + network errors.
- If queue exceeds config.max_queue_size, oldest low-priority events are dropped (LRU by rule priority).

Config example (client init, YAML style embedded):
init({
  apiKey: "pk_live_xxx",
  env: "production",
  maxQueueSize: 5000,
  batchSize: 50,
  sendIntervalMs: 2000,
  samplingConfigUrl: "https://config.rw/telemetry/sampling.json",
  privacy: {redactPatterns: ["email","phone"], allowlist: ["p_feature_flag"]},
  diagnostics: {enable: false} // set true in staging
})

Edge cases / open questions (TODO):
- How to handle very large prop values (e.g., long prompts)? Should we attach a token_count metric plus truncation+hash fingerprint? Recommend: add p_text_hash and n_token_count, send truncated text only when rule explicitly allows.
- Are we comfortable shipping HMAC keys in mobile SDK? Use per-install ephemeral key + server-side exchange? Need security review.
- Compatibility matrix for older SDKs: shim should accept older event shapes and upgrade them at client-side before enqueue.
- Server-side dedup semantics for retransmitted batches. Need batch_id + deterministic event_id to dedupe.

Implementation notes / pseudocode:
- track(e):
   norm = normalize(e)
   apply_redaction(norm)
   add_provenance(norm)
   if !evaluate_sampling(norm): return false
   enqueue(norm)
   if queue.length >= batchSize or time >= sendInterval -> flushAsync()

- flushAsync():
   batch = queue.take(batchSize)
   sendToCollector(batch) with timeout 8s
   on 5xx or network fail: requeue with backoff, increment retry counter

Diagnostics API (for devs only):
- shim.inspect() -> {queueDepth, lastFlushDurationMs, lastError, samplingSnapshot} (only in dev builds or when diagnostics enabled)

Security / compliance notes:
- Tag events with schema_version and privacy_flags so downstream processors can drop or route events to compliant sinks.
- Support server-side contracted retention TTLs in the batch metadata.

TODO (short list):
- [ ] finalize sampling DSL grammar and implement fast evaluator (no regex if avoidable)
- [ ] figure mobile key management + HMAC flow (security)
- [ ] add unit tests for redaction patterns + edge truncation
- [ ] sync with data-platform on dedupe and retention headers

Links and references:
- Linear ENG-2345: client shim MVP
- GH PR: rw-client/pull/402 (init + track basic)
- Slack: #telemetry-ingest (see thread from Feb 12 for sampling debate)

Notes to self: keep the shim interface minimal so product teams adopt it. Sampling is the secret-sauce: make it expressive but small. Consider shipping a "preview rules" mode for staging to validate sample volumes without affecting production stream.

—— end
